question: In SPL set f4853677-1622-4037-688b-fdf533a11d96 version 74, section '5.1 Presence of Gastric Malignancy' (direct text only), classify 'gastric malignancy'.
supporting_quote_or_value: symptomatic response to therapy with NEXIUM does not preclude the presence of gastric malignancy
rationale: Gastric malignancy is a pre-existing condition whose symptoms Nexium may mask; the label does not say Nexium causes it.
uncertainty: Not a classic risk factor for a reaction; it is a condition that may be hidden. The class list has no 'masked condition' option, so this is the closest fit. Scoped to SPL f4853677-1622-4037-688b-fdf533a11d96 v74 (effectiveTime 20251219) and this passage only.
